'''Ged''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Ged was a member of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], and served in the battles of [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] and [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Teth]] before he was [[Death|killed]] in action on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] during the Republic's attempt to rescue [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the child of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Biography==
===Battle of Christophsis===
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], seven weeks after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="Wild Space" /><ref name="ERC" /> the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion]] was deployed<ref name="TCWf" /> to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].<ref name="Christophsis">{{SWE|locations|christophsis|Christophsis}}</ref> The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had taken control of the strategically-valuable world, which was vital for its position in the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] breached through the blockade around the planet, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led elements of the [[Thirteenth Army]] and the 501st into battle against the Confederacy forces in the capital city [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Chaleydonia]], better known as the Crystal City. Although the beginning of the Battle of Christophsis was ridden with failure for the 501st, the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] of the 501st prepared their offensive against [[Droid Army|droid]] forces led by Confederacy [[General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]].<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>

[[File:Battle_of_Christophsis.png|thumb|left|250px|Republic forces desperately fight off waves of Confederacy battle droids on Christophsis]]
After the initial stages of the Battle of Christophsis concluded, the Confederacy launched a counterattack on the 501st's forces, whose only remaining hope was a battery of [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]]. Although the 501st had lost all of its armor in the early days of the battle, the clone infantry prepared a defense against the overwhelming Confederacy forces.<ref name="TCWf" /> Ged, among his comrades in [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], was on the front line of this offensive. Although he managed to survive the counterattack before the [[Battle droid/Legends|droids]] retreated, Ged was injured on the shoulder by jagged shrapnel that had penetrated the gap between his backplate and shoulder armor, and reported back to the [[forward aid station]] for treatment.<ref name="TCWn" />

====Counterattack====
{{Quote|What's the plan then, sir?''"<br />"''Follow me.''"<br />"''Right you are, sir&hellip;|Ged and Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, discussing plans to repel the Separatist assault on Christophsis|<ref name="TCWn" />}}Shortly after having his arm tended to by clone [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Coric]], the Confederacy attacked a second time. Ged once again entered the battle, this time following Skywalker and clone [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], "Rex" against a trio of [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuparra droids]] encroaching on the Republic's AV-7 [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]]. The clone forces took position above the main droid force and [[Rappel line|rappelled]] down into the fray, led by Skywalker. Led by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], the clones were able to repel the droid attack once again, although they continued to sustain heavy [[Death|casualties]].<ref name="TCWn" />

====Final defense====
[[File:Christophsis_shield.png|thumb|right|250px|General Loathsom advances his droid troops behind the energy shield, unopposed.]]
After repelling the counterattack, the Republic was able to enjoy a lull in the previously relentless combat. However, the peace was not to last, as the Confederacy attacked once again, this time using an [[Energy shielding|energy shield]] to guard their approach on the Republic's position.<ref name="TCWf" /> Led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General Obi-Wan Kenobi and clone [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] "Cody", the 501st—including Ged<ref name="TCWn" />—once again engaged the droid forces once they entered the perimeter of the energy shield. As they were pushed back, Skywalker and his new [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], desperately attempted to shut down the energy shield to allow the Republic's cannons to fire upon the droids. After the defeat of the Confederacy forces, Ged and the rest of Torrent Company were recalled for a new assignment<ref name="TCWf" /> to the Outer Rim world<ref name="Teth Databank">{{SWE|locations|teth|Teth}}</ref> of [[Teth]].<ref name="TCWf" />

===Battle of Teth===
[[File:ATTE_scale_cliff.png|thumb|left|250px|Torrent Company, supported by [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] walkers, scale the cliff face leading to the monastery.]]
The 501st was given little time to recover from the meat-grinder of Christophsis, and was deployed directly to Teth, an Outer Rim planet bordering on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The unit was assigned to recapture [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], the offspring of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. According to [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]] was being held inside a former [[B'omarr Monastery]] on the planet.<ref name="TCWf" /> Ged was assigned to the mission along with the men of Torrent Company, disregarding his wounds. His unit sustained heavy casualties as they were forced to scale the sheer walls of the [[Monastery/Legends|monastery]], but Ged was able to survive the ascent.<ref name="TCWn" /> Once they arrived at the monastery, the surviving members of Torrent Company prepared to defend the entrance while Skywalker and Tano retrieved the Hutt.<ref name="TCWf" />

====Defending the monastery====
{{Quote|If we can't stop them, then we delay them as long as we can, and after that we make sure they have to crawl over our bodies. It's been an honor, gentlemen.|Clone Captain Rex, addressing the surviving men of Torrent Company|<ref name="ERC" />}}
[[File:Confederate_counterassault.png|thumb|right|250px|Confederate battle droids overwhelm the monastery defense.]]
Once the Hutt was recaptured, the Republic force once again came under attack from at least one squadron of Confederacy [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture starfighters]] and battle droids. The survivors of Torrent Company assumed positions at the entrance of the monastery, preparing [[Trap (tactic)|traps]] for the oncoming onslaught of enemy forces. Ged was one of the forty-two combat-ready soldiers left in the company as the clones prepared to defend the monastery, buying time for the Jedi to escape with the Hutt. Preparing for an overwhelming assault, Ged readied a tripwire in front of the door, while the rest of the unit laid ordinance in the alcoves of the monastery walls and even in their backpacks. Torrent Company was prepared to defend till the last man, and would force the droids to walk over their dead bodies to reach the Jedi.<ref name="TCWn" />

The droid forces, led by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Assassin/Legends|Assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], made short work of the heavy door guarding the monastery entrance.<ref name="TCWf" /> As the droids marched through the doorway, Ged's charges detonated, and the clone troopers opened fire. Ged was gunned down by the onslaught of battle droids entering the monastery, along with most of his comrades. However, the soldiers were able to hold off the Confederacy long enough for Skywalker to complete the mission, but at a great cost. In the aftermath of the battle, just six members of Torrent Company would remain.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You could sit this one out, Ged.''"<br />"''I get lonely, sir.''"<br />"''We'll keep you company, then...|Clone Captain Rex and Ged, preparing to engage Confederacy forces on Christophsis|<ref name="ERC" />}}
As a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] clone of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Ged stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" /> Ged was a competent clone soldier, and was eager to fight on Christophsis, and subsequently Teth, even after being injured.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Equipment==
Ged was equipped with a set of [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|phase I clone trooper armor]], and also carried supplies to create a tripwire during the Battle of Teth.<ref name="TCWn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ged first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="TCWn" />
